brief: Cut a 60-second highlight of this long workshop recording: open on the strongest moment, show the making steps clearly, and end on the finished piece.

candidates.label: Finished bowl opener
candidates.reason: Opens with 'This is the finished oak bowl, oiled and ready for the table.' then 'It started as a rough blank from a fallen tree.' Strongest hook for 60-second highlight.

candidates.label: Raw blank intro
candidates.reason: Says 'Here is the raw oak blank still wet and heavy.' then 'the grain tells me where the bowl wants to be.' Establishes starting material.

candidates.label: Lathe shaping demo
candidates.reason: Says 'On the lathe the shape appears in long steady cuts.' then 'I keep the wall wall thickness even from rim to base.' Clear making step.

candidates.label: Sanding glow turn
candidates.reason: Says 'Sanding goes from coarse to fine with the lathe turning slowly.' then 'this is where the grain starts to glow' Turning point in finish.

candidates.label: Oiled ready ending
candidates.reason: Says 'a coat of food safe oil brings out the color.' then '24 hours later the bowl is ready to use' Ideal ending on finished piece.
